term.label: TR_V_pseudogene

definition.text: A pseudogenic variable region which closely resembles a known functional T receptor variable gene but in which the coding region has stop codons, frameshift mutations or a mutation that effects the initiation codon that rearranges at the DNA level and codes the variable region of an immunoglobulin chain.

comments: These terms have been requested by Adam Frankish to support Gencode and Vega biotypes. The terms are defined according to IGMT.
